image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched on green vegetation. The wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is light brown with distinct rows of eyespots (ocelli) featuring black centers and yellow rings. The body appears fuzzy/hairy and dark brown. The background consists of out-of-focus green grass blades.
